title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Judges 20: Israel gathers at Mizpah and goes to war against Benjamin over the crime at Gibeah.

questions.text: Where did the congregation of Israel assemble before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: All the children of Israel went out, from Dan even to Beersheba, and assembled as one man to Yahweh at Mizpah.

questions.text: How many footmen who drew sword presented themselves in the assembly?
questions.explanation: The chiefs of all the tribes presented themselves in the assembly, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.

questions.text: What did the tribes of Israel ask Benjamin to hand over?
questions.explanation: They said, "Deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death."

answers.text: The wicked men who were in Gibeah

questions.text: What was special about the seven hundred chosen men of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: They were left-handed, and every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

answers.text: They were archers who fought on horseback
They were left-handed slingers who never missed
They were the tallest men in Israel
They could run faster than any chariot

questions.text: When Israel asked God at Bethel who should go up first against Benjamin, what was the answer?
questions.explanation: They asked who should go up first to battle against Benjamin, and Yahweh said, "Judah first."

questions.text: How many Israelite men did Benjamin destroy on the first day of battle?
questions.explanation: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men.

questions.text: Who stood before the ark of the covenant in those days?
questions.explanation: The ark of the covenant of God was there, and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days.

questions.text: What did Israel set all around Gibeah before the third day of battle?
questions.explanation: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

questions.text: What was the agreed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers?
questions.explanation: The appointed sign was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.

answers.text: The blowing of a ram's horn trumpet
A banner raised high on a hill
A great cloud of smoke rising from the city
A loud shout from the city gate

questions.text: Where did six hundred men of Benjamin flee and stay for four months?
questions.explanation: Six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed there four months.
